scope: Development-only diagnostic refits on ATTACK_FIT_NEW, evaluated on INNER_SELECTION
timing: All 40 R4 attack jobs were DONE when this rule was recorded. The fixed 40-slot aggregate, final comparison selection and R5 refits had not yet occurred. This is a bounded post-outcome diagnostic subset, not a prospectively frozen attack subset.
arm_rule: Include P0, the pre-final-attack FIT nominee V_L, and the strongest eligible final pair-AUC control under the fixed equal-seed mean and tie order. Deduplicate any repeated arm.
common_reader: HGB_15x200 with the source's fixed ATT group split and attacker seed; require prediction parity to the frozen R4 reader
additional_reader: HGB_31x300 with learning rate 0.05, no early stopping, random state 20261010+source_seed; one fixed stronger diagnostic
selection: No best-seed, best-draw, or post-refit comparator choice; report all scheduled units including failures.
